patterns.note: Extensive use of full-bleed, high-quality photography and video, often presented in large, immersive sections or side-by-side pairs, dominating the visual space.
Product display sections feature a flexible grid of smaller images, allowing for varied product presentation and visual browsing.
Headings use an elegant, classic serif typeface, creating a luxurious feel, contrasting with a clean, modern sans-serif for body text and navigation.
A sophisticated, muted color palette dominated by warm neutrals (beiges, greys, browns) derived directly from product photography, complemented by stark black and white for text and backgrounds.
A sticky navigation bar at the top of the page transitions from a transparent overlay with white text to an opaque white background with black text as the user scrolls down.
The hero section features a full-width background video that plays silently, creating an immersive and dynamic introduction to the brand.

technique_notes: The hero section uses a full-bleed, silent background video to establish an immediate sense of luxury and motion, with key messaging overlaid in a prominent serif typeface.

A sticky header navigation is implemented, which dynamically changes its background color and text color from transparent/light to opaque/dark as the user scrolls past the initial hero section, maintaining visibility and brand presence.

Content sections are primarily composed of large, editorial-style photographs, often full-width or arranged in a two-column grid, with minimal text overlays or adjacent descriptions, allowing the visuals to convey the product's appeal.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, elegant serif headings (~3-4x body) with smaller, clean sans-serif body text and uppercase navigation labels.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners are consistently used across all elements, from image frames to buttons.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy and generous, particularly around large image sections and the hero, creating a sense of luxury and allowing visuals to breathe. Product grids maintain a balanced density.

standout: The site's distinctive use of high-fashion, editorial-quality photography and video as the primary storytelling mechanism, minimizing text to create an immersive, gallery-like experience that feels more like browsing a luxury magazine than a typical e-commerce site.
